messages.author: 0ee8ae7c0d185529
messages.subject: Plots for monitored parameters using mcmcextra
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to get diagnostic plots for mcmcextra parameters and it does not appear possible using the plot command.  I'm getting the plots for all of the other parameters except those defined in the mcmcextra lines.  I can output the mcmc draws from blavInspect, but I would prefer to see the diagnostic plots provided by blavaan.  Any thoughts?

Thank you,

David

I am not sure how blavaan read which parameters to use for the plots. So, the mcmcextra might be out of that list

Once you exported the mcmc draws with blavinspect. You can create these plots with the bayesplot package, they have all the functions for trace plots etc. That should give you what you want

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Plots for monitored parameters using mcmcextra
parts:
It looks like the plot() command in blavaan will not currently allow plotting of things from mcmcextra. But the plots are actually coming from the bayesplot package, and it is not too tough to get those plots after extracting the draws. For your model, you could do something like this:

## extract + arrange draws in the needed way:
draws <- aperm(as.array(blavInspect(fit_horse, 'mcmc')), c(1, 3, 2))

## trace plots:
library(bayesplot)
mcmc_trace(draws, pars = c('lambda_p', 'tau'))

And this page shows you many different plots that are available from bayesplot (the commands usually start with "mcmc_"):

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/bayesplot/vignettes/plotting-mcmc-draws.html

Ed
